properties.notes: The site is not connected to a settlement but is within walking distance of the facilities and services in Chipstead. The existing access onto Chevening Road could be utilised. The site lies within the AONB but is considered to be well contained. Overall the part of the site fronting Chevening Road is considered able to accommodate development however it is located within the Green Belt so this designation would need to change in order for it to be developed.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
